answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments anchor each agent's history to a Merkle root, while a zero-knowledge verifiable delay seeded by a VRF-derived lotus nonce forces any Sybil forger to expend work beyond the staked copper collateral. The protocol slashes copper-denominated bonds proportionally to detected duplicate identities, yielding negative expected attack utility for any coalition. Under these primitives the game converges to a robust Nash equilibrium where honest validators in the grove prefer attestation over economically prohibitive delay penalties.
